newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan loses 12 pct on Shenzhen debut.
newsitem.headline: Changan loses 12 pct on Shenzhen debut.

text.p: Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd, which listed 250 million B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Friday, closed the first day's trading down 12.17 percent on unexpected institutional selling, traders said.
The stock opened at an intra-day high of HK$1.97 and fell steadily for the rest of the session to close at a low of HK$1.66 against an issue price of HK$1.89 per share.
The stock became the first Shenzhen B share this year to end below the issue price on its first day of trading.
The debut was in sharp contrast to active buying of the company's B shares on the primary market. The issue was six times over-subscribed.
Brokers said the stock was pushed down by selling by unexpected overseas institutions but they were at a loss to explain the selling.
One analyst suggested it could be a reflection of the poor performance of the Shanghai B share market, which has hit record closing lows on four of the past five sessions.
